title: Chicken Balti
method: Heat oil over medium heat, fry cumin seeds 30 seconds until spluttering.
Add garlic and ginger; fry 30 seconds.
Add cubed chicken and sear 3-4 minutes until sealed.
Add fresh tomatoes and cook 5-7 minutes until soft.
Stir in tomato puree and yoghurt; cook 8-10 minutes until oil separates.
Add spices, fenugreek, and salt; simmer 5-7 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Melt butter into curry before removing from heat.
